description: Test systemic categorization: architectural or process-level change

findings.message: God module detected: core.ts has 50+ exports

causalTraces.traced_cause: No architecture documentation or review process
causalTraces.mechanism: Without architecture governance, technical debt compounds

recommendations.action: Establish architecture governance: 1) Create ADR template and initial ADRs for module structure, 2) Add architecture diagram to docs/, 3) Add architecture review checklist to PR template
recommendations.rationale: Individual fixes won't prevent future architectural drift. A governance process ensures ongoing architectural health.

assumptions: Team has capacity for architecture review process

expected_properties.category_rationale: Systemic because it requires organizational/process change, not just code changes
